The Three Mile Island nuclear plant's Unit 2 has been decommissioned since 1979 due to a major accident, and Unit 1 was permanently shut down in 2019. Restarting either unit by 2028 would require reversing decades of decommissioning, overcoming regulatory hurdles, securing massive capital investment, and addressing public opposition—all deemed implausible within the timeframe.
